ex.zh: 她的目光從我轉到巴比身上。

ex.en: The government announced an important shift in policy.
ex.zh: 政府宣佈了政策上的重大轉變。

ex.en: Each student must get the signature of their parents.
ex.zh: 每個學生都必須得到父母的簽名。

ex.en: Misfortune tests the sincerity of friends.
ex.zh: 不幸能考驗朋友的真誠。

ex.en: The building is built on a good site in town.
ex.zh: 這棟建築蓋在鎮上的好地點。

ex.en: They are looking for a site for their new factory.
ex.zh: 他們正為新工廠找地點。

ex.en: He drew a sketch of the ballet dancer.
ex.zh: 他為這個芭蕾舞者畫了一張素描。

ex.en: She plugged the electric appliance into the socket.
ex.zh: 她將電器插頭插到插座裡。

ex.en: He turned the soil with a spade.
ex.zh: 他用鐵鍬把土翻了一遍。

ex.en: Can you spare me a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你能為我挪出幾分鐘時間嗎？

ex.en: The mother spared no effort to take care of her sick daughter.
ex.zh: 這母親不遺餘力地照顧生病的女兒。

ex.en: Luckily, I was spared the trouble of explanation.
ex.zh: 幸好我省了解釋的麻煩。

ex.en: What do you do in your spare time?
ex.zh: 你閒暇時間都在做些什麼？

ex.en: Families should prepare spare keys in case of need.
ex.zh: 家庭應該有備用鑰匙以防萬一。

ex.en: Spears are their tools for hunting.
ex.zh: 矛是他們狩獵的工具。

ex.en: The teacher split the class into groups of four.
ex.zh: 老師把班上分成四人一組。

ex.en: The issue may split the party.
ex.zh: 這個議題可能會使這個政黨分裂。

ex.en: She sprinkled sugar over strawberries.
ex.zh: 她在草莓上灑點糖。

ex.en: The region is sprinkled with small lakes.
ex.zh: 這一區有許多小湖泊星羅棋佈。

ex.en: Soon it began to sprinkle.
ex.zh: 不久下起了毛毛雨。

ex.en: The man was stabbed to death in his office.
ex.zh: 這男士在辦公室裡被刺身亡。

ex.en: According to the statistics, eight people die each day waiting for a transplant.
ex.zh: 根據統計，每天有八人在等待器官移植的過程中死亡。

ex.en: The florist varied the lengths of the flower stems to make the display more interesting.
ex.zh: 花店店員將花莖長度剪得各有不同讓花朵呈現方式變得更有意思。

ex.en: The rescue team tied a belt around the victim's thigh to stem the flow of blood.
ex.zh: 救難隊將皮帶綁在傷患的大腿上止血。

ex.en: Their breakup actually stemmed from a slight misunderstanding.
ex.zh: 他們其實是因小誤會而分手。

ex.en: Let's not watch TV. Let's listen to music on the stereo.
ex.zh: 別看電視了，來聽聽立體音響吧。

ex.en: She tried to save money without being stingy.
ex.zh: 她設法節約錢但不想吝嗇。

ex.en: Many girls prefer socks to stockings nowadays.
ex.zh: 現在很多女孩喜歡短襪勝過長襪。

ex.en: A zebra has black stripes.
ex.zh: 斑馬有黑色的條紋。

ex.en: This is the goal we are striving for.
ex.zh: 這是我們奮鬥的目標。

ex.en: He strove to live up to his reputation as a straight A student.
ex.zh: 他努力要維持他優等生的名譽。

ex.en: Susan looked after her father after he had a stroke.
ex.zh: 蘇珊在父親中風後就照顧他。

ex.en: He paints with broad strokes.
ex.zh: 他用粗線條繪畫。

ex.en: She lovingly stroked the baby's face with the tips of her fingers.
ex.zh: 她以指尖疼愛地輕摸嬰兒的臉龐。

ex.en: A submarine can stay under water for weeks at a time.
ex.zh: 潛水艇一次可以在水面下停留數週之久。

ex.en: The news of the celebrity couple suing each other for domestic violence has made the headlines.
ex.zh: 這對名人夫妻互控家暴的新聞上了頭條。

ex.en: He is a famous plastic surgeon.
ex.zh: 他是有名的整形醫生。

ex.en: The criminal surrendered himself to the police.
ex.zh: 罪犯向警方自首。

ex.en: He surrendered to temptation and took out a cigarette.
ex.zh: 他無法抗拒誘惑，於是掏出一根菸。

ex.en: The gangsters are on the point of surrender.
ex.zh: 歹徒要投降了。

ex.en: Nowadays, most people live in safe and comfortable surroundings.
ex.zh: 現今大多數的人住在安全舒適的環境中。

ex.en: I am suspicious of their intentions.
ex.zh: 我懷疑他們的意圖。

ex.en: He was behaving in a highly suspicious manner.
ex.zh: 他的舉止相當可疑。

ex.en: The branches are swaying gently in the wind.
ex.zh: 樹枝在風中輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: Her speech failed to sway her colleagues into supporting the plan.
The word "lady" has two syllables.
ex.zh: 「lady」這個字有兩個音節。

ex.en: She is sympathetic to the homeless girl on TV.
ex.zh: 她對電視上這個無家可歸的女孩感到同情。

ex.en: We sympathized with our classmate whose mother was very ill.
ex.zh: 我們十分同情那位母親得了重病的同學。

ex.en: I need to develop a more systematic method for organizing my work to boost efficiency.
ex.zh: 我需要發展更有系統的方法來組織工作以提升效率。

ex.en: Mother telegraphed me yesterday.
ex.zh: 媽媽昨天打電報給我。

ex.en: The news came by telegraph.
ex.zh: 這則新聞是用電報傳來的。

ex.en: He looked through his telescope at the approaching ship.
ex.zh: 他透過望遠鏡看著駛近的輪船。

ex.en: Exercise is an ideal way to relieve tension.
ex.zh: 運動是舒緩緊張的好方法。

ex.en: The tension was so great that the rope broke.
ex.zh: 繩子拉得太緊繃斷了。

ex.en: The little girl screamed in terror.
ex.zh: 這個小女孩害怕地尖叫。

ex.en: The film was a thorough success.
ex.zh: 這電影獲得極大的成功。

ex.en: They did a thorough search of the area but found nothing.
ex.zh: 他們仔細搜尋了這個區域，但是什麼都沒找到。

ex.en: It was really thoughtful of you to remember my birthday.
ex.zh: 你真是體貼，記住了我的生日。

ex.en: That put us all in a thoughtful mood.
ex.zh: 這使我們大家陷入了沈思。

ex.en: Our school usually outlines the timetable of events for the entire semester two months before school begins.
ex.zh: 我們學校通常在開學前兩個月會規劃好整個學期的行事曆。

ex.en: He does not like his job, but is too timid to try to find another.
ex.zh: 他不喜歡自己的工作，但膽子太小不敢嘗試另找工作。

ex.en: The pain has become tolerable.
ex.zh: 疼痛變得可以忍受了。

ex.en: The government showed more tolerance toward opposition groups.
ex.zh: 政府展現了對於反對團體更多的寬容。

ex.en: The chairman was tolerant of different views.
ex.zh: 主席包容不同的意見。

ex.en: It is believed that men are less tolerant of stress than women.
ex.zh: 據說男人比女人更不能忍受壓力。

ex.en: Compared with other trees, beefwood is more tolerant of drought.
ex.zh: 和其他樹相較之下，木麻黃比較耐旱。

ex.en: I cannot tolerate your bad manners.
ex.zh: 我不能容忍你的無禮行為。

ex.en: We visited the tomb of Shakespeare.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了莎士比亞的墓。

ex.en: Have you read the story of "the Tortoise and the Hare"?
ex.zh: 你讀過龜兔賽跑的故事嗎？

ex.en: She suffered tortures from a toothache.
ex.zh: 她受牙痛的折磨。

ex.en: The police tortured him to confess his crime.
ex.zh: 警察拷打，逼他招供。

ex.en: The film studio is transferring to Hollywood.
ex.zh: 片廠要遷至好萊塢。

ex.en: She was transferred to another department.
ex.zh: 她被調往另一部門。

ex.en: The aging king transferred power to his son.
ex.zh: 年邁的國王把權力移交給他的兒子。

ex.en: I would like to transfer US$ 1000 to this account.
ex.zh: 我要匯 1000 元美金到這個戶頭。

ex.en: The Greggs have transformed their garage into a guest house.
ex.zh: 格雷格一家把他們的車庫改成了客房。

ex.en: Her voice trembled with anger.
ex.zh: 她的聲音因憤怒而顫抖。

ex.en: There was a tremble in her voice as she told us the story.
ex.zh: 她告訴我們那個故事時,聲音顫抖著。

ex.en: He tumbled over and hit his head on the concrete.
ex.zh: 他摔倒，頭撞到水泥地。

ex.en: He had a tumble and hurt his knee.
ex.zh: 他跌了一跤，傷到了膝蓋。

ex.en: He made a fire with dry twigs.
ex.zh: 他用乾樹枝生火。

ex.en: The ultimate goal of the project is to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 這個專案的最終目標是減少碳排放。

ex.en: This car represents the ultimate in luxury and performance.
ex.zh: 這輛車代表了豪華與性能的極致。

ex.en: Popular cultures seem to have universal appeal.
ex.zh: 流行文化似乎對所有人都有吸引力。

ex.en: A universal truth is true or suitable in every situation.
ex.zh: 真理在各種情況下都適用。

ex.en: They urged us to go at once.
ex.zh: 他們催促我們馬上去。

ex.en: There is a vacancy on the tenth floor.
ex.zh: 第十層樓上有一個空房間。

ex.en: The rich woman is vain and extravagant.
ex.zh: 這富家女既虛榮又奢侈。

ex.en: All our efforts are in vain.
ex.zh: 我們所有努力都白費了。

ex.en: Camels trekked across a vast desert.
ex.zh: 駱駝跋涉穿過一片遼闊的沙漠。

ex.en: The government will have to borrow vast amounts of money.
ex.zh: 政府必須籌措很多的錢。

ex.en: New Zealand has banned vessels carrying nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: 紐西蘭已經禁止載有核子武器的船隻入境。

ex.en: Cups, basins, pots, bottles, and casks are vessels that hold liquids.
ex.zh: 杯、盆、罐、瓶、桶都是盛液體的容器。

ex.en: Arteries are vessels that carry blood away from the heart in a human or animal body.
ex.zh: 動脈是人體或動物體內將血液帶離心臟的管子。

ex.en: The way they treat women represents a violation of human rights.
ex.zh: 他們對待女性的方式就是形同侵犯人權。

ex.en: The voyage from America to France used to take two months.
ex.zh: 從美國航行到法國,過去要花二個月時間。

ex.en: Our only concern is children's welfare.
ex.zh: 我們唯一關心的是孩童的福利。

ex.en: Most of the people in this neighborhood are on welfare.
ex.zh: 大多數住這附近的人都領救濟金。

ex.en: The beggar boy lived on his wits.
ex.zh: 童丐靠機智維生。

ex.en: We are advised to have 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity workouts per week to stay fit.
ex.zh: 我們被建議每週要劇烈運動 75 分鐘以保持身體健康。

ex.en: The driver was still alive when (he was) pulled from the wreck.
ex.zh: 當駕駛從車子的殘骸中被拉出來時仍然活著。

ex.en: A boat was wrecked in the storms.
ex.zh: 有艘船毀在暴風雨中。

ex.en: He stretched himself with a yawn.
ex.zh: 他打了個呵欠伸了伸懶腰。

ex.en: He kept yawning the whole time I was talking to him.
ex.zh: 我和他說話時，他從頭到尾不停地打呵欠。

ex.en: He has not finished his homework yet.
ex.zh: 他還沒有完成他的作業。

ex.en: The test was hard, yet I passed it.
ex.zh: 考試很難，但我通過了。

ex.en: The zipper on my skirt has broken.
ex.zh: 我裙子拉鍊已經壞掉了。
